title: How to set colours and text styles

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: How to set colours and text styles

slide_intent: Set the document theme before drawing charts so repeated visual choices stay consistent.
strategic_value: Named color and font themes can make Helsinki chart production less dependent on manual styling.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: two Excel screenshots show the font and color menus beside charts, each paired with instructions.
practical_value: Set Arial and the default HKI_L_tunnusvarit palette through Page Layout before chart work.

content_islands.name: Font theme
content_islands.spec: Upper text and screenshot locate the font menu.

content_islands.name: Color theme
content_islands.spec: Lower text and screenshot locate the custom color themes.

reference_purposes.Application: The source specifies Page Layout font/color menus, Arial as the general font theme and HKI_L_tunnusvarit as the default palette.
